title: The Disk Substructures at High Angular Resolution Project (DSHARP). IX. A High-definition Study of the HD 163296 Planet-forming Disk
question: What are the morphology of the dust rings, the CO emission geometry, temperature and dust extinction optical depth of the HD 163296 disk at ~4 au resolution, and do the asymmetries support planet-disk interaction?

data.sensitivity: continuum rms 0.023 mJy/beam; CO rms 0.84 mJy/beam per channel

what.value: Model temperature profiles of HD 163296 compared with observations

evidence.quote: compares the temperature inferred from the 1.25 mm dust continuum intensity to the models discussed in (cite: isella16), (cite: rosenfeld13a), and (cite: flaherty15).

external_data.citation: Isella et al. 2016; Rosenfeld et al. 2013; Flaherty et al. 2015

what.value: Gaussian-ring widths from radial profile fits

evidence.quote: Here, we compare the widths of the HD 163296 rings measured by Dullemond et al. (2018)

what.value: Planet-disk simulation model (0.15 MJ planet at 54 au)

evidence.loc: 5.2 On the origin of the dust rings
evidence.quote: The model is part of the suite of models presented in Zhang et al. (2018)

recipe.method: Fit crests and troughs with ellipses using emcee, following Huang et al. (2018)

recipe.goal: Fit axisymmetric Gaussian ring model in the uv plane
recipe.method: Sum of 5 Gaussian rings, Fourier transformed at observed uvs; chi2 sampled with emcee; 19 free parameters
key_parameters: 200 walkers, 10^4 burn-in steps, convergence after ~4x10^4 steps

recipe.method: Subtract best-fit Gaussian model from visibilities and image residuals; fit crescents with 2D Gaussian in polar plane
Compare parametric isovelocity curves with z_co = z0 (r/r0)^q to the channel maps
assumptions: i=46.7 deg, stellar mass 2.0 Msun, Keplerian rotation

recipe.goal: Measure dust extinction optical depth from CO absorption
recipe.method: Ratio of unattenuated CO (from gaps) to observed back-side CO at rings along 18 azimuths; tau = ln ratio
assumptions: tau_d << 1 in gaps; epsilon between 0.1 and 1

recipe.goal: CO gas temperature profile and compare with models
recipe.method: Peak-intensity temperature map from non-continuum-subtracted data, deprojected with z_co
assumptions: CO peak optically thick and in LTE

evidence.quote: The peak intensity is 0.64 mJy beam$^{-1}$, corresponding to a signal-to-noise ratio of 28.
The systemic velocity inferred from CO observations is 5.8 km s$^{-1}$

not_stated_but_needed: CLEAN masks, niter and threshold for tclean
Continuum channel selection and line-free channels for CO continuum subtraction
emcee priors and bounds for the visibility Gaussian-ring fit
How the azimuthal intensity ratios and 18 lines of sight were extracted
Exact Birnstiel et al. source function parameters used for temperatures
score_reason: Public data and script, but several fitting details are not given.
rediscovery_reason: Data are public, the recipe is largely stated, and the main results are numeric (ring widths, tau, T_co).
